profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Motivated Software Engineer with Project Management experience interested in the burgeoning potential of machine learning and dynamic, intelligent and distributed systems.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Increased System Efficiency: Enhanced the performance of loyalty-benefit rewards and status programs architecture, leading to a 30% reduction in processing time for key transactions.
• Service Development: Successfully built and deployed over 15 microservices using Spring Boot, Azure Functions, and Azure Service Bus, handling over 500,000 transactions per day.
• Improved Data Flow: Architected and implemented a caching solution using Redis, reducing data retrieval times by 40%.
• Security Enhancements: Integrated multiple security and reporting tools (Sonarqube, Coverity, BlackDuck, Mezmo, Nucleus) that increased code quality and security compliance by 25%.
• Production Releases: Led the deployment of 10+ major production releases, ensuring zero downtime and seamless user experience.
• Automated Processes: Automated key processes including certificate creation, proxy setup, and Azure Key Vault secret management, reducing manual effort by 50%.
• Collaboration and Leadership: Worked collaboratively across 5 cross-functional teams to modernize the loyalty and status programs, resulting in a 20% increase in user engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Microservices · Software Design · Spring Framework · Spring Data · AngularJS · Azure DevOps Services · Problem Solving · Front-End Development · Solution Architecture · Communication · Algorithms · Decision Trees

positions.title: Software Engineer Project Lead
positions.description:
• Internship Program Leadership: Coordinated and led a highly successful summer internship program, conducting over 100 hours of training in Java/Spring, React, GCP Cloud Services, and Agile Methodologies. Mentored 30 interns, resulting in a 90% intern-to-full-time conversion rate.
• Team Enablement and Training: Led seven teams of new hires through a comprehensive enablement program, providing technical training and project management guidance. Successfully onboarded and allocated 20+ individuals to client projects within 2 months, reducing ramp-up time by 50%.
• Project Management Promotion: Promoted to Project Manager for a high-profile client project, overseeing the development of a carbon circular registry and accounting system. Streamlined the process of issuing, retiring, and maintaining carbon certificates, which improved system efficiency by 40%.
• Process Automation: Spearheaded the automation of critical business processes, leading to a 30% reduction in manual efforts and a 25% increase in operational accuracy.
• Client Satisfaction: Achieved a 95% client satisfaction rate by delivering high-quality projects on time and within budget. Conducted regular client meetings and progress updates, ensuring alignment with client goals and expectations.
• Agile Methodologies Implementation: Implemented Agile methodologies across all projects, resulting in a 20% increase in team productivity and a 15% decrease in project delivery times.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Worked closely with cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative environment that led to innovative solutions and a 30% improvement in project outcomes.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Spring Framework · Java · JavaScript · Jenkins · SQL · React.js · Software Design · Agile Methodologies · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · TypeScript · Problem Solving · Communication · Scrum · Docker · Apache Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · Team Leadership · Microservices · AngularJS · TDD · REST APIs

positions.title: 3D Printer Tech & Software Specialist
positions.description:
• Custom Software Solutions: Developed and implemented custom software solutions to streamline production processes, improving overall system efficiency by 30%. Leveraged coding skills to create automation scripts for printer management, reducing manual intervention by 50%.
• Advanced Software Management: Managed Prusa model slicing software, making precise adjustments to printing profiles. This resulted in a less than 5% fail rate, significantly enhancing production efficiency and reducing material wastage.
• Product Pipeline Management: Oversaw the entire product pipeline, including production, website listings, and customer service. Utilized Shopify custom plugins to develop interactive 3D model viewers, integrated customer comments and feedback systems, and implemented a custom color/parts selector, enhancing user experience and increasing online sales by 25%.
• Workflow Optimization: Created efficient workflows for 97 Prusa printers, reducing production to shipping time by 40%. This optimization enabled the company to take on 10 additional projects months ahead of their initial scheduling, increasing overall productivity.
• COVID-19 Response Initiative: Led a critical project during the COVID-19 pandemic to print and deliver several thousand face shields to hospitals in Seattle. This effort involved coordinating logistics, ensuring quality control, and meeting urgent deadlines, ultimately contributing to public health efforts.
• Technical Documentation: Created comprehensive technical documentation for all software and workflow processes, facilitating knowledge transfer and ensuring consistent operational practices across the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Software Design · Web Development · Software Development · Problem Solving · Algorithms · Communication

positions.title: English Teacher
positions.description:
• Top teacher for 4 weeks (non-consecutive) with the most student retention and positive feedback/reviews.

• Structured my own lesson plans and delivered quality teaching where my students consistently scored the highest on exams.

positions.title: Intern - Market Research/Financial Analyst
positions.description: • Organized and analyzed data for potential online markets which led to the company's main products being placed in several new boutique online stores.

positions.title: Spanish Teacher
positions.description:
• Reorganized scheduling for our area classrooms and teachers allowing us to make space for three new cohorts per month

• Created and reached challenging learning goals with students on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis leading to almost 100% proficiency across all metrics.
